chapter.title: Natural or Cultured Pearls, Precious or Semiprecious Stones, Precious Metals, Metals Clad With Precious Metal, and Articles Thereof; Imitation Jewelry; Coin

page.h1: HTS Chapter 71: Natural or Cultured Pearls, Precious or Semiprecious Stones, Precious Metals, Metals Clad With Precious Metal, and Articles Thereof; Imitation Jewelry; Coin — Export Markets & Foreign Tariffs on U.S. Goods

seo.title: Chapter 71 Export Markets: Tariffs on U.S. Gold & Jewelry by Country
seo.shortDescription: The tariff each top buyer charges on U.S. gold, silver, diamonds and jewelry, with the trade agreement and regulator for each.

intro: For the largest buyers, tariffs on U.S. gold, silver and diamonds are zero. Switzerland abolished its industrial tariffs for every country in 2024, and Hong Kong, the EU, Canada, Singapore and Australia charge nothing on bullion. The tariffs that do exist are on jewelry (about 2.5% in the EU, about 5% in the UAE) and on gold in India. What decides access is a regulator's approval: hallmarking in the UK and Switzerland, responsible-sourcing due diligence in the EU and UAE, and Kimberley Process certificates for rough diamonds almost everywhere.
valueBasis: FOB value of U.S. exports, as reported by the United States to UN Comtrade.

assumptions: Rates come from each market's customs tariff or trade agreement where they could be confirmed. Switzerland abolished customs duties on industrial goods for all origins from January 1, 2024; where a 2026 figure was not confirmed, the cell says 'not individually verified' or 'not re-verified'.
Eighteen headings are shown, but four (gold 7108, other precious-metal articles 7115, jewelry 7113 and silver 7106) are about 82% of the chapter. The small headings carry the market-wide default.

India's gold rate is shown as 6% (the rate set in July 2024 by the Union Budget) with the report of a 15% rate from May 2026 flagged as unconfirmed. Check the CBIC notification before pricing a shipment.
VAT and similar taxes on investment gold (for example the UK's VAT exemption) are the buyer's business and are not shown.
National 8–10-digit tariff lines can set a different rate than the four-digit group shown here — check the market's own schedule before relying on this page for a transaction.
